children: traded higher on Tuesday after updating long-term data from a mid-stage trial for its lead candidate, tegoprubart, and announcing the FDA's Fast Track designation for the candidate.

Citing data from its Phase 2 BESTOW trial, the biotech said the antibody therapy maintained a higher kidney function with a statistically significant effect, based on the average estimated glomerular filtration rate, a measure of kidney graft function.
BESTOW was designed to evaluate tegoprubart versus the immunosuppressant drug, tacrolimus, for the prevention of transplant rejection in individuals undergoing kidney transplantation.
Compared with an average eGFR of about 69 mL/min/1.73 m² in a 12-month
, the latest readout presented at the International Congress of the Transplantation Society in Australia set its eGFR advantage at approximately 13 mL/min/1.73 m² through 24 months.
As for safety, the company said that there were no rejections in the tegoprubart arm beyond six months post-transplant compared with seven in the tacrolimus arm.
